reviews.text: Jara delivered as promised! He was professional, knowledgeable, and affordable. Thank you Jara!
reviews.author: Miguel R.

reviews.text: I had a large pine tree that was leaning and partially uprooted. Jara promptly responded to my message, showed up when he said, quoted a fair price and did an outstanding job with removing the tree /clean up.
reviews.author: Corinne B.

reviews.text: Jara took on a major project in the nature of the demolition/excavation of a 33,000 gallon in-ground pool, along with filling/compacting, and seeding. He was very timely in arriving and going over the project requirements.
reviews.author: Deacon L.
